Package entityClasses

Class LessonLearnedList

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonLearnedList
public class LessonLearnedList extends Object

Title: LessonLearnedList Class.

Description: Entity collection manager that encapsulates all persistent lessons learned in the system as well as arbitrary search/filter subsets. Implements full in-memory CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) capabilities, defensive input validation, and forward-compatible hooks for TP3 Administrative moderation, staff verification, and community endorsements.

Architectural Pattern: Part of the Entity / Model layer in Foundations MVC architecture. Decouples collection manipulation from JavaFX UI views and JDBC database operations.

    • getAllLessons

      public List<LessonLearned> getAllLessons()
      Returns an unmodifiable view of all lessons learned.

      Requirement Trace: US-HW2-02 (Acceptance Criterion a).

      Rationale: Wrapping with Collections.unmodifiableList prevents external callers from corrupting internal collection state without using class CRUD mutators.

      Returns:
      unmodifiable List containing all LessonLearned instances
